claims.evidence: Witness confirms boxes and manual say D750, but seller's own follow-up text claims 'The model is D850', directly conflicting with the photographed boxes/manual and with the seller's first sentence.
Only outer boxes and bubble-wrapped interior shown; actual body/lens surfaces and cosmetic condition not visible.
No power-on, shutter-fire, or lens autofocus test shown; only packaging and manuals are visible.

risks.risk: Seller states two different models (D750 vs D850) for the same item
risks.proof: A clear video showing the camera body's top-plate model badge and serial number matching the box
risks.if_unproven: Treat as unverified identity mismatch; price at worst case (lowest-value/most-doubtful model) or withhold pricing until resolved

risks.proof: Photo or screen capture of shutter count from a shutter-count app or menu display

risks.risk: Functionality of camera, lens, and gimbal not demonstrated
risks.proof: Power-on video showing sensor, autofocus, and gimbal motor operation

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, gimbal mount)
risks.proof: Flat-lay photo of all included accessories next to the body

risks.risk: Authenticity of Nikon and ZHIYUN items (counterfeit boxes are common)
risks.proof: Close-up of serial numbers on body, lens, and gimbal matching official Nikon/ZHIYUN registration formats
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified authenticity, worst case counterfeit risk

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage inside wrapped packaging (Photo 2)
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-up photos of each item inside the box
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly damaged until shown otherwise

proof_requests: Clear photo/video of the camera body's top-plate model name and serial number
Power-on video demonstrating shutter, autofocus, and screen function
Shutter count screenshot from menu or app
Full accessory flat-lay (battery, charger, strap, memory card, gimbal mount)
Close-up of lens glass and mount for scratches/fungus
Serial number close-ups for authenticity check on body, lens, and gimbal
response.reason: The seller's own message contradicts itself and the witnessed box/manual evidence by naming two different camera models (D750 vs D850), a classic inconsistency pattern seen in scam listings.
